brokers.cost: Average yearly cost of two profiles at published prices for a TFSA with $20,000: active (two Canadian and one US trade a month, $6,000 converted to US dollars a year in four conversions) and buy-and-hold (one Canadian trade a month). Trades are $2,000 orders of 40 shares; US-dollar fees are counted at par. Where a broker publishes no conversion rate or only an undisclosed spread, its conversion cost is counted at the median published rate of 1.5%. Score = 5 minus the average cost divided by $80, from 0 to 5.
brokers.accounts: Half a point for each of 10 account types: TFSA, RRSP, spousal RRSP, FHSA, RESP, RRIF, LIRA or LIF, margin, joint and corporate.
brokers.us: USD in registered accounts: 2 if offered with no fee, 1 if a fee applies, 0.5 if not stated. Conversion fee: 2 at 0.1% or less, 1.25 up to 1.3%, 1 at 1.5%, 0.75 above 1.5%, 0.5 if not published. US commission: 1 at $0, 0.75 at $2 or less, 0 above.
brokers.cash_margin: CAD margin rate under $100,000: 2.5 at 4% or less, 2 up to 5%, 1.5 up to 6%, 1 up to 6.5%, 0.5 above 6.5% or not published. Headline interest on uninvested CAD cash: 2.5 at 1% or more, 1 above 0%, 0 otherwise; rates paid only on balances above $1,000,000 are not counted.
brokers.platform: One point each for fractional shares, DRIP, options, an advanced trading platform and a mobile app; half a point where only partly offered or not named.
brokers.safety: 4 when CIRO and CIPF membership are both stated by the broker, 3.5 when CIPF membership is confirmed and CIRO membership follows from it; plus 1 when the broker is owned by a bank or a financial cooperative group.
brokers.beginner_platform: Fractional shares 1.5, a mobile app 1.5, DRIP 1 and no account minimum 1 (0.5 where the minimum is not stated).
brokers.ties: Scores are shown to one decimal. Ties are ordered by the unrounded score, then by name.
brokers.options_cost: Yearly cost of four US equity options trades a month of two contracts each; score = 5 minus cost divided by $120, from 0 to 5.

robos.fees: Management fee plus the highest published fund cost (MER) for the core portfolios, on $50,000: score = 5 minus (total % minus 0.35) x 5.
robos.accounts: Half a point for each of 10 account types.
robos.minimum: The stated minimum, or where none is stated, the lowest balance in the published fee schedule (Wealthsimple Core starts at $1; Questwealth's lowest fee tier starts at $250): 5 at $100 or less, 4.5 up to $500, 4 above.
robos.advice: 5 = planners or advisors for every client; 4.5 = advisors by phone or email; 2 = no client advice described.
robos.not_ranked_rule: A robo-advisor is ranked only when both its management fee schedule and its fund costs are published in text we can verify.

crypto.fees: Published trading fee f%: 5 minus (f minus 0.2) x 2.5; 2.5 where only an undisclosed spread or no fee schedule is published.
crypto.coins: 5 at 150 or more, 4 at 100, 3 at 50, 2 at 10, 1 below; 2.5 if not published.
crypto.features: 3 for staking available in Canada, 2 for crypto withdrawals to outside wallets.
crypto.funding: 5 = free CAD deposits and withdrawals; 4 = free deposits, fees or no statement on withdrawals; 2.5 = not published.
crypto.regulation: 5 = CIRO investment dealer and CIPF member; 4 = on CIPF's member list; 3 = registered with securities regulators (for example as a restricted dealer) but not on CIPF's list. Only platforms on the CSA list of authorized crypto trading platforms are included.

tax_software.price: 5 = a full-featured free tier; 3.5 = free only for simple returns; 3 = price not published.
tax_software.features: 5 = all income types including self-employment and investments; 4 = most; 3 = basic or not confirmed.
tax_software.support: 5 = expert review or full service available; 4 = expert consultation on a paid tier; 3 = phone support; 1 = none.

chequing.fees: 5.0 = $0 monthly fee with no conditions; 4.5 = $0 monthly fee but per-transaction fees below a balance of $1,000 or less; 3.0 = fee of $4 or less a month; 2.5 = fee over $15 a month waived at a daily balance of $4,500 or less; 1.5 = fee over $15 a month with no balance waiver
chequing.interest: Everyday interest rate on the chequing balance with no paid plan, interpolated: 0% = 0, 1% = 2.5, 2% = 4.0, 2.75% or more = 5.0. Rate not published = 0. Direct-deposit bonus rates count at half their extra value
chequing.transactions: 5.0 = unlimited transactions and free e-Transfers; 3.0 = 18 transactions a month with e-Transfers included; 2.5 = 12 transactions a month; minus 0.5 if sending an e-Transfer costs a fee
chequing.atm: 5.0 = no ATM fee anywhere in Canada (or fees reimbursed); 4.0 = large own network plus a shared network, fees elsewhere; 3.5 = own network, fees elsewhere; 2.5 = fees at all ATMs or not published
chequing.protection_features: 5.0 = CDIC member (in its own right or through its parent bank) whose account does not rule out cheques; 4.0 = CDIC member whose account offers no cheques; 3.5 = deposits held in trust at CDIC members (provider not a member) with a chequebook available; 3.0 = held in trust at CDIC members, with cheques not offered or not stated
